story.title: Eleni Makri brought in the most revenue

explain.a-sumifs: Two conditions: rep and channel. SUMIFS puts the range to add first.
explain.b-sumifs: Two conditions: product and region. SUMIFS puts the range to add first.
explain.a-countifs: "10 or more" includes 10: the criterion is ">=10", in quotes.
explain.b-countifs: Count rows where both conditions hold.
explain.a-logic: Attica's units ÷ Attica's orders, wrapped in ROUND(…,1).
explain.b-logic: Units means the Quantity column, summed; not the number of orders.
explain.a-vlookup: Category is the 3rd column of J:N. End with FALSE.
explain.b-vlookup: ListPrice is the 5th column of J:N; UnitCost is the 4th. End with FALSE.
explain.a-approx: Tiers are bands, so this is an approximate match (TRUE): the largest MinQty ≤ the quantity.
explain.b-approx: Tiers are bands, so this is an approximate match (TRUE): the largest MinQty ≤ the quantity.
explain.a-index: Search RepName (Q), return RepID (P): INDEX/MATCH with 0, or XLOOKUP.
explain.b-index: Search ProductName (K), return ProductID (J): INDEX/MATCH with 0, or XLOOKUP.
explain.a-lookup-math: Revenue = Quantity × ListPrice × (1 − Discount); then subtract Quantity × UnitCost.
explain.b-lookup-math: O1141's product (P015) isn't in the price list yet, so the lookup is #N/A; IFERROR turns that into 0.
explain.a-clean-1: Remove Duplicates (every column); then fill only the blank Regions with a lookup of the rep's name in Q:R.
explain.a-clean-2: TRIM(PROPER()) down D; Convert to Number on G; Find & Replace in C (whole cell); sort by Date to find the 2026 slip.
explain.b-clean-1: TRIM(PROPER()) filled down D; Convert to Number on G.
explain.b-clean-2: Remove Duplicates; lookup into the blank Regions; Find & Replace in C (whole cell); sort by Date to find the 2026 slip.
explain.a-pivot-story: Rows: Category; Values: Sum of Margin; refreshed after cleaning. Columns or bars, largest first; the title names the top category.
explain.b-pivot-story: Rows: Rep; Values: Sum of Revenue; refreshed after cleaning. Columns or bars, largest first; the title names the top rep.
